baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered recitation, deliberate turning, self-magnification, doubled as-if construction, and ear-weight image form one reception sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: An intelligible sound arrives in sequence, but the addressee withdraws from acceptance and performs the result as though a bodily obstruction had prevented hearing. The second comparison externalizes a chosen stance as an ear-load.

activation_trace.role: Ordered following makes the recitation an arriving sequence whose continuation the hearer interrupts.
Withdrawal from proximity and listening supplies the deliberate break in reception.
Self-exalting refusal supplies the motive for treating reception as beneath the hearer.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes the denied hearing a refusal of uptake, not merely absent sound.
The ear's image of listening and accepting locates the failure at the threshold between sound and assent.
Literal heaviness in the ear gives the chosen refusal a simulated bodily mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that an arrogant person is effectively deaf to revelation.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages nonhearing as a performance: sound reaches him, but pride blocks the transition from audition to accepting response and is pictured as self-installed ear-weight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to announce is immediately filled by painful punishment rather than welcome news.
baseline_models.mechanism: The communicative form is retained while its affective value is reversed. The one who acts beyond hearing receives an announcement whose painful content converts an ignored verbal message into unavoidable sensation.

activation_trace.role: Joy-opening news, explicitly capable of hostile qualification, supplies the ironic announcement frame.
Punitive hurt reverses the normal value of the announcement.
Pain inflicted by something painful makes the final message bodily rather than merely informational.

changed_reading.before: The last clause adds a conventional threat after the refusal.
changed_reading.after: The last clause is a designed counter-message: ignored audition is answered by an inverted announcement that will be registered as pain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding scene gives the listener an acquired rival stream: purchased discourse occupies attention, diverts it from a traversable way, and recodes signs as ridicule. Ear-weight therefore reads as active channel capture rather than empty incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as acceptance identifies the precise uptake function displaced by the rival stream.
A carried load lets ear-weight function as accumulated attentional ballast.
Exchange and purchase make the competing input deliberately acquired rather than accidental noise.
Occupation by one thing away from another supplies the attentional diversion.
Renewed talk supplies an ongoing counter-discourse capable of filling the listening channel.
Deviation from guidance gives the occupied channel its directional effect.
Ridicule converts the incoming signs from a claim to receive into an object to dismiss.

structural_cues: 31:6 immediately precedes 31:7 and moves from acquiring diversionary discourse to refusing recited signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purchased diverting speech, misdirection, mockery, and then simulated nonhearing; I infer that a chosen counterstream preloads attention. A live alternative is that the two ayat only list adjacent traits of the same type.

changed_reading.before: The hearer blocks an otherwise open message.
changed_reading.after: The hearer has allocated the channel to a purchased counterstream, so the claimed ear-blockage is the downstream effect of chosen attention and ridicule.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later instructions unfold arrogant nonhearing into a whole sensorimotor display: cheek and neck incline away, gait advertises conceit, boasting projects status, and the outgoing voice requires deliberate lowering. Incoming suppression and outgoing self-display are opposite operations of one posture.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the focus movement that the later cheek posture anatomizes.
Self-magnification binds the focus movement to the later display behaviors.
The proud inclination of cheek and neck gives the focus turning a precise bodily pose.
Conceit displayed in gait extends refusal from the ear into locomotion and public bearing.
Boastful status recital supplies the outward speech that accompanies inward refusal.
Deliberately reducing and lowering supplies the corrective control for projected sound.
Repeated audible voice makes the social soundscape explicit and contrasts output with refused input.

structural_cues: The paired instructions in 31:18-19 move without a break from cheek and gait to voice, placing bodily orientation and acoustics in one etiquette sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proud cheek-tilt, conceited gait, boast, and lowered voice; I infer a common self-presentation system with 31:7. A live alternative is that these are parallel ethical examples rather than an anatomy of the focus refusal.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance is an inward motive that causes the person not to listen.
changed_reading.after: Arrogance is an embodied sound policy: the body turns and enlarges its display while regulating what may enter and failing to restrain what it projects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The listener is not unable to follow; he is committed to another chain. Ordered recitation competes with repeated following of what was found with the fathers, while a rival call bends that inherited sequence toward punishment.

activation_trace.role: Following in ordered succession lets recitation present itself as a sequence inviting continuation.
Repeated trailing and following supplies the rival behavioral sequence.
Finding something already present makes inherited availability substitute for tested reception.
Paternal formation and upbringing identify the social carrier of the competing chain.
A call that inclines by speech makes the rival allegiance acoustic and directs it toward the announced punishment.

structural_cues: 31:21 repeats the follow verb on both sides of a command to follow what was sent down, staging explicit competition between sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered recitation, repeated following, inherited finding, and a rival call; I infer competing transmission chains rather than no receptivity at all. A live alternative is that following here is only ideological imitation, not an acoustic counter-allegiance.

changed_reading.before: The person turns away from instruction as such.
changed_reading.after: The person refuses one followable sequence because hearing is already pledged to an inherited chain whose own call carries him toward the threatened end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self-positioned burden in the ears is answered by forced movement into materially thick punishment. Agency and force reverse: chosen receptive heaviness becomes an imposed consequence whose thickness cannot be turned away from.

activation_trace.role: A heavy carried load supplies the material quality first placed in the ears.
Punitive hurt is the common endpoint whose texture the later scene intensifies.
Necessity and compulsion reverse the earlier freedom to turn away.
Bodily thickness after thinness gives punishment a material density answering the ear-load.

structural_cues: 31:24 repeats punishment after a short delay and places compulsion immediately before its description as thick.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ear-load, punishment, compulsion, and thickness; I infer a transfer and reversal of material force from offense to consequence. A live alternative is that heaviness and thickness are independent idioms of severity.

changed_reading.before: The punishment is painful because it follows arrogant refusal.
changed_reading.after: The punishment formally answers the refusal: voluntary ballast at the receptive threshold returns as compulsory thickness around the refuser.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus hearer makes himself large in order to stand above signs; the later truth-versus-falsehood frame names true highness and greatness elsewhere. His nonhearing becomes a scale error: borrowed magnitude is used to demote the message.

activation_trace.role: Human self-exaltation supplies the attempted enlargement that blocks reception.
Majesty and supremacy establish the true upper scale against which the hearer's posture is measured.
The same greatness image, now in the closing divine predicate, exposes human self-magnification as counterfeit.

structural_cues: 31:30 frames its paired highness and greatness predicates after an explicit truth-versus-falsehood contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated magnitude root and an adjacent true/false contrast; I infer that the later scale judges the earlier self-enlargement. A live alternative is that the closing predicates conclude the cosmological argument without retrospectively targeting 31:7.

changed_reading.before: The hearer is too proud to listen.
changed_reading.after: The hearer manufactures a false vertical scale, enlarging himself over signs whose source alone occupies the named position of true highness and greatness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covering danger produces purified address; rescue then permits knowledgeable denial and betrayal to return. The apparent deafness of the focus is therefore reversible and state-dependent: pressure can clear the chosen blockage, while safety allows it to be reinstalled.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as acceptance defines the reception state that crisis temporarily reopens.
Ear blockage supplies the apparently fixed condition that the later temporal sequence makes reversible.
An external covering danger replaces the internally simulated cover and initiates the state change.
Exclusive separation from competing allegiance supplies the temporary clarity of address under pressure.
Rescue by separation marks the transition back into safety where the receptive state can change again.
Denial despite knowledge confirms that later nonreception is strategic rather than informational.
Betrayal and failure to keep faith explain how crisis-clarity is abandoned after rescue.

structural_cues: The when-then sequence of 31:32 moves from covering waves to exclusive call to rescue to denial, while signs recur across 31:31-32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering crisis, exclusive address, rescue, informed denial, and betrayal; I infer a pressure-sensitive reception switch. A live alternative is that the plural scene presents a related human type rather than the same singular figure across states.

changed_reading.before: Pride has made the focus hearer stably unreceptive.
changed_reading.after: The blockage is a reversible policy rather than a lost faculty: crisis can suspend it, and restored safety can reactivate informed denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates legal and temporal side-images beneath ordinary recitation and announcement. It remains anchored in the focus sequence of reciting, leaving, and announcing; downstream prose should present it as an exploratory lexical image, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressee leaves after recitation, yet the command to announce follows his departure.

activation_trace.role: A liability or right that follows its bearer lets the recited claim remain attached after refusal.
Leaving after prior company supplies the attempted separation from the encountered signs.
First indications of a coming thing turn the warning into an onset that trails the departure.

changed_reading.before: Turning away ends the communicative encounter and punishment is mentioned afterward.
changed_reading.after: Turning away fails to discharge the recited claim; its first consequential signs continue after the hearer as something still owed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses neighboring weight and dignity branches and exploits a contrast inside one root inventory. It remains anchored to self-magnification, the accepting ear, and ear-weight; downstream prose should qualify it as wordplay-like latent activation rather than lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse places self-important posture beside a weight lodged at the organ of acceptance.

activation_trace.role: Elevated status and headship supply the prestige the hearer performs.
Listening as acceptance identifies what the performed prestige disables.
Dignified gravitas supplies the socially valued face of the weight image.
Heavy ballast supplies the same image's disabling material face.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance and ear-heaviness are separate moral and sensory descriptions.
changed_reading.after: The gravitas he performs congeals into ballast: claimed dignity itself becomes the weight that disables accepting hearing.

strongest_changes: The ear-blockage became chosen channel capture by purchased counter-discourse rather than lack of input.
Later cheek, gait, boast, and voice controls made nonhearing an embodied policy of self-display.
Competing follow-chains and crisis-dependent reversal showed that receptivity persists but is selectively pledged or suppressed.
Forced thick punishment materially reverses the voluntary weight first installed at the receptive threshold.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting mechanisms: performed deafness, inverted announcement, attention capture, bodily acoustic posture, inherited counter-following, force reversal, counterfeit scale, and reversible crisis reception. The strangest live images are a recited claim that follows its bearer and performed gravitas becoming ear-ballast.
remaining_uncertainties: The weight-to-thickness transfer may be deliberate material analogy or only parallel severity language.
The divine magnitude predicates may retrospectively expose the focus arrogance or may function independently in the cosmological close.
The crisis sequence describes a plural type, so its pressure-sensitive hearing model need not narrate the identical individual of 31:7.
The pursuing-claim and gravitas-as-ballast outliers depend on branch-distant activation and should remain explicitly exploratory.
